SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Extensive Sign Reading Fiction and Non- Fiction Texts (1000- 1250 words) Poems (not more than 5 stanzas) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: Independent learning as learners, individually, read and sign read the selected materials.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: Reflection as learners share reflections on the books read and sign read.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners, in groups or pairs, fingerspell and sign words related to the theme; technology.

Link to other Subjects:

The learner applies the skill of extensive reading to select and read non-fiction materials in all the learning areas.
